1	import autogen
2	from autogen import LLMConfig
3	import re
4	from requests.packages.urllib3.exceptions import InsecureRequestWarning
5	import requests
6	from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
7	import textwrap
8	
9	requests.packages.urllib3.disable_warnings(InsecureRequestWarning)
10	
11	
12	# code retrieved from https://stackoverflow.com/questions/79019497/retrieving-news-articles-from-yahoo-finance-canada-website
13	def getUuids(companyName):
14	    url = "https://ca.finance.yahoo.com/_finance_doubledown/api/resource?bkt=finance-CA-en-CA-def&device=desktop&ecma=modern"
15	    data = {
16	        "requests": {
17	            "g0": {
18	                "resource": "StreamService",
19	                "operation": "read",
20	                "params": {
21	                    "forceJpg": True,
22	                    "releasesParams": {"limit": 50, "offset": 0},
23	                    "ncpParams": {
24	                        "query": {
25	                            "id": "tickers-news-stream",
26	                            "version": "v1",
27	                            "namespace": "finance",
28	                            "listAlias": "finance-CA-en-CA-ticker-news",
29	                        }
30	                    },
31	                    "useNCP": True,
32	                    "batches": {
33	                        "pagination": True,
34	                        "size": 10,
35	                        "timeout": 1500,
36	                        "total": 170,
37	                    },
38	                    "category": f"YFINANCE:{companyName}",
39	                },
40	            }
41	        }
42	    }
43	    headers = {
44	        "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Ubuntu; Linux x86_64; rv:130.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/130.0",
45	        "Content-Type": "application/json",
46	    }
47	    resp = requests.post(url, json=data, headers=headers, verify=False).json()
48	    return resp["g0"]["data"]["stream_pagination"]["gqlVariables"]["tickerStream"][
49	        "pagination"
50	    ]["uuids"]
51	
52	
53	# llm_config = {"config_list": config_list, "timeout": 60}
54	
55	llm_config = LLMConfig(
56	    {"api_type": "openai", "model": "gpt-4o"},
57	    cache_seed=42,
58	    temperature=0.1,
59	    timeout=60,
60	)
61	
62	financial_assistant = autogen.AssistantAgent(
63	    name="financial_assistant",
64	    llm_config=llm_config,
65	)
66	
67	research_assistant = autogen.AssistantAgent(
68	    name="research_assistant",
69	    llm_config=llm_config,
70	)
71	
72	report_writer = autogen.AssistantAgent(
73	    name="report_writer",
74	    llm_config=llm_config,
75	)
76	
77	user_proxy = autogen.UserProxyAgent(
78	    name="user_proxy",
79	    human_input_mode="NEVER",
80	    max_consecutive_auto_reply=10,
81	    code_execution_config={
82	        "work_dir": "workspace",
83	        "use_docker": False,
84	    },
85	)
86	
87	
88	# code retrieved and modified from https://stackoverflow.com/questions/79019497/retrieving-news-articles-from-yahoo-finance-canada-website
89	@financial_assistant.register_for_llm(
90	    name="get_news_links", description="Get news links to a given company code."
91	)
92	@user_proxy.register_for_execution(name="get_news_links")
93	def get_news_links(companyCode: str) -> str:
94	    result = getUuids(companyCode)
95	    remove_junk = re.sub(":STORY|:VIDEO", "", result)
96	    result_url = f"https://ca.finance.yahoo.com/caas/content/article/?uuid={remove_junk}&appid=article2_csn"
97	    result_resp = requests.get(result_url, verify=False).json()
98	
99	    all_links = ""
100	    max_news = 5
101	    for i in result_resp["items"]:
102	        try:
103	            news_modifiedDate = i["data"]["partnerData"]["modifiedDate"]
104	            if "2025" in news_modifiedDate:
105	                news_urls = i["data"]["partnerData"]["finalUrl"]
106	                news_title = i["data"]["partnerData"]["pageTitle"]
107	                all_links += f"News URL:  {news_urls}\nModifiedDate: {news_modifiedDate}\nTitle: {news_title}\n\n"
108	                max_news -= 1
109	        except Exception:
110	            pass
111	        if max_news == 0:
112	            break
113	
114	    if all_links == "":
115	        return "No news found. The company code may be incorrect, or please use a different way to search for news."
116	
117	    return all_links
118	
119	
120	@financial_assistant.register_for_llm(
121	    name="summarize_news", description="Summarize news from a given URL."
122	)
123	@user_proxy.register_for_execution(name="summarize_news")
124	def scrape_and_summarize_yahoo_finance(url: str, summary_length=1000) -> str:
125	    """
126	    Scrapes a Yahoo Finance article from the given URL and returns a summarized version.
127	
128	    Parameters:
129	    - url (str): The URL of the Yahoo Finance article.
130	    - summary_length (int): The number of characters to include in the summary.
131	
132	    Returns:
133	    - str: A summarized version of the article.
134	    """
135	    try:
136	        headers = {"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"}
137	        response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
138	        response.raise_for_status()  # Raise an error for bad responses
139	
140	        # Parse the content using BeautifulSoup
141	        soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, "html.parser")
142	
143	        # Extract the article text
144	        article_paragraphs = soup.find_all("p")
145	        article_text = "\n".join([p.get_text() for p in article_paragraphs])
146	
147	        # Summarize the content
148	        summary = textwrap.fill(article_text[:summary_length], width=80)
149	        return summary
150	
151	    except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e:
152	        return f"Error fetching article: {e}"
153	
154	
155	async def main():
156	
157	    # get user input
158	    stock_str = input("Enter the stock you want to investigate: ")
159	
160	    financial_tasks = [
161	        f"Can you read recent news about {stock_str} stock? Retrieve the news links and get summaries for all news using functions.",
162	        f"Get the Monthly, 3 Months, YTD and one-year stock price change for {stock_str}. Plot a 1-year stock price change graph and save to `stock_price_change.png`.",
163	        "You are given recent news and price changes about a stock. please write a comprehensive market analysis report in markdown and give your conclusion on whether to hold, sell or buy it. Incorporating all findings, and include the plot `stock_price_change.png` from the previous task. Return the report in ```markdown``` format.",
164	    ]
165	
166	    # Run the first two tasks asynchronously
167	    news_summary_task = user_proxy.a_initiate_chat(
168	        recipient=financial_assistant,
169	        message=financial_tasks[0],
170	        summary_method="reflection_with_llm",
171	        summary_args={
172	            "summary_prompt": "Please summaize the news content of the stock. Include details and url references to the news articles."
173	        },
174	    )
175	    price_change_task = user_proxy.a_initiate_chat(
176	        recipient=research_assistant,
177	        message=financial_tasks[1],
178	        summary_method="reflection_with_llm",
179	        summary_args={
180	            "summary_prompt": "Please give the requested stock price changes numbers and share your findings."
181	        },
182	    )
183	
184	    # Gather the first two tasks and wait for their completion
185	    news_summary, price_change = await asyncio.gather(
186	        news_summary_task, price_change_task
